Here's a PyChrono simulation script implementing the requested features:

```python
import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.irrlicht as irr
import numpy as np

def main():
    # Create the Chrono system
    system = chrono.ChSystemNSC()
    system.SetTimestep(0.01)  # Set simulation time step

    # Create the Irrlicht visualization
    app = irr.ChIrrApp(system, 'HMMWV on Complex Terrain', irr.dimension2du(1024,768))
    app.SetCamera(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 10), chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0))
    app.AddTypicalLights()
    app.AddTypicalLogo()
    app.AddTypicalSky()

    # Create terrain system
    terrain = veh.ChTerrain(system)

    # Add flat terrain patches with different textures
    # First patch (base)
    patch1 = veh.ChFlatTerrainPatch()
    patch1.material.mu = 0.9
    patch1.material.cr = 0.9
    patch1.material.y = 2e7
    patch1.texture_path = "textures/grass.jpg"
    patch1.texture_scale = (10,10)
    terrain.AddPatch(patch1)

    # Second flat patch with different texture
    patch2 = veh.ChFlatTerrainPatch()
    patch2.material.mu = 0.8
    patch2.texture_path = "textures/dirt.jpg"
    patch2.texture_scale = (5,5)
    patch2.SetPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(20, 0, 0))  # Position next to first patch
    terrain.AddPatch(patch2)

    # Heightmap-based terrain patch
    # Create sample heightmap data (replace with real data for actual use)
    heightmap_size = 10
    heightmap_res = 0.2
    nx = int(heightmap_size / heightmap_res) + 1
    nz = nx
    heightmap_data = np.zeros((nx, nz))
    for i in range(nx):
        for j in range(nz):
            x = i * heightmap_res - heightmap_size/2
            z = j * heightmap_res - heightmap_size/2
            dist = np.sqrt(x*x + z*z)
            if dist < 3:
                heightmap_data[i,j] = 0.5*(1 - dist/3)
    
    patch3 = veh.ChHeightmapTerrainPatch()
    patch3.SetHeightmapData(heightmap_data, heightmap_size, heightmap_size, heightmap_res)
    patch3.SetPosition(chrono.ChVectorD(-10, 0, 0))  # Position on left side
    terrain.AddPatch(patch3)

    # Add a mesh-based bump (cylinder)
    bump = chrono.ChBodyEasyCylinder(0.5, 2,  # radius, height
                                    1000,  # density
                                    True,  # visualization
                                    True,  # collision
                                    chrono.ChColor(0.5,0.5,0))  # gray color
    bump.SetPos(chrono.ChVectorD(10, 0, 0.5))  # Position on right side
    system.Add(bump)

    # Create HMMWV vehicle
    vehicle = veh.HMMWV_V8()
    vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0,0,0.3), chrono.QUNIT))
    vehicle.Initialize(system, terrain, True)  # Enable visualization

    # Create interactive driver
    driver = veh.ChInteractiveDriverIrrlicht(app.GetInput())
    driver.SetVehicle(vehicle.GetChassis())
    driver.SetTimestep(system.GetSettings().timestep)

    # Simulation loop
    while app.GetDevice().run():
        time = system.GetChTime()
        
        # Update driver inputs
        driver.Synchronize(time)
        driver.Update()
        
        # Advance simulation
        system.DoStepDynamics(system.GetSettings().timestep)
        
        # Render
        app.BeginScene()
        app.DrawAll()
        app.EndScene()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
```
